findings.claim: Among 255 pre-cut input_readiness_runs, curator duration is null/zero/positive in 7/75/173 rows and validator duration in 22/99/134.
Positive-only pre-cut medians/p90 are curator 28,148/115,850.6 ms and validator 78,758.5/257,428.6 ms; zero/null semantics are not established.
The first three planned queries exposed schema mismatches; discovery identified the actual tables/columns instead of treating query errors as product failures.
Six pre-cut direct requests map to five distinct runs; none are unfinished and no finished_at precedes requested_at.
There are 62 same-screen+same-source-snapshot run pairs with non-null curator/validator durations, but this is not yet a controlled matched intervention comparison.
Across 493 pre-cut validator chunks, component sums exceed duration_ms in 385 rows, so stage fields cannot safely be treated as additive without semantic documentation.

assumptions.text: Null and zero durations have unknown semantics unless a revision contract defines them.
Same pantalla_id+source_snapshot_sha256 reduces but does not eliminate workload/intervention confounding.
Chunk component timings may overlap or nest; arithmetic additivity is not assumed.
Schema/query errors reflect investigator query mismatch unless product behavior is independently implicated.

justifications.claim: Direct request/run mapping is many-to-one in at least one case
Candidate matched pairs exist but causal equivalence is unproven
Chunk timing components are non-additive under naive summation

nogoods.invalidates_if: Zeros are semantically valid completed zero-cost stages.
invalidates_claims: Any inference that zero durations indicate missing telemetry or defect

nogoods.invalidates_if: Same snapshot pairs differ materially in family_count, revision, route or cache reuse.
invalidates_claims: Any causal before/after comparison based only on the 62 pairs

nogoods.invalidates_if: Component timings are documented as overlapping/nested.
invalidates_claims: Any claim that components_gt_total is a telemetry defect

nogoods.invalidates_if: A failed SQL query is due to stale investigator schema assumptions.
invalidates_claims: Any claim that query errors are runtime failures

propagation.result: Keep descriptive counts; remove missing-telemetry interpretation.
Downgrade matched-pair causal claims to descriptive only.
Retain non-additivity observation; remove defect implication.
Classify the 3 failures as query-design errors and use discovered schema.

alternative_supports: A valid causal performance claim requires controlled matched workload, canonical e2e clock, revision semantics and reuse markers.

E.rationale: Performance telemetry is measurable but not causally attributable because duration semantics, additive meaning, matched intervention boundary and reuse effects remain unresolved.
potential_falsifiers: Governed matched replay controls source, workload, revision, cache/reuse and e2e clock.
Matched replay demonstrates attributable regression or excludes it.

reversal_criteria.to_REPAIR_REQUIRED: Controlled matched evidence proves material attributable regression.
reversal_criteria.to_VERIFY_FIRST: A bounded governed verification protocol closes the remaining confounders.
reversal_criteria.to_NO_ACTION_SUPPORTED: Matched complete evidence excludes material regression.

negative_falsifiers: Do not treat p50/p90 as causal improvement/regression without matched cohorts.
Do not treat zero durations as missing or valid without semantics.
Do not sum chunk components as mutually exclusive stages.
Do not classify investigator SQL schema errors as product failures.
next_safe_step: Define canonical timing semantics and run a governed matched replay before any performance repair.
